scope: Timing-only cache levels and capacity; interpretation of two completed rounds, without specification validation.

capacity_estimates.evidence: 64 B random, huge pages: round-2 32 KiB medians 3.90625/4.0; 36 KiB 10.671875 TSC ticks/load. At 16 KiB the coarse median is 3.671875.
64 B random, huge pages: round-2 256 KiB medians 10.921875/10.8828125; 288 KiB 17.40625; 320 KiB 23.2265625 TSC ticks/load.

64 B random, huge pages at 5/6/7/8 MiB: 33.1796875/36.7421875/113.3359375/170.5859375 ticks/load. At 8 MiB the compact 8 B layout repeat medians are 87.9375/87.9453125. Primary-layout 7 MiB temporal block medians span 99.0703125-217.234375.
capacity_estimates.interpretation: Broad effective transition after the plateau at 5 MiB; not a bound on nominal physical capacity.

caveats: Other benchmarks were observed on CPUs 0/4 before both rounds; shared-cache and memory-system interference was not isolated.
LLC timing depends on layout/page policy and varies over time; no unique nominal physical LLC capacity is inferred.
Intervals are empirical sampling neighborhoods, not statistical confidence intervals or hardware specification bounds.
third_round: Not run. The requested two rounds are complete; narrower L1/L2 empirical brackets would require separately selected refinement.
